name: Wire the game UI into the game host

comments.text: Deferred from L6 (lantern #28 review): crates/game-host host.rs's HandleEvent mouse tracking, navigate_ui, update_ui after OnStart and in Render, report_ui_messages and keeping the application Value alive for GameUi, plus the platformer tests in tests/headless_game.rs that need Chaos. GameHost.nox has none of these yet, and lantern::ui is registered as failing until Chaos starts.

Done. GameHost tracks the mouse, navigates the UI before OnUpdate, updates it after OnStart and OnRender, reports Chaos messages as UI errors and draws it at uiScale/2. ScriptSession owns a GameUiState (the ChaosUi, the application value and the navigation actions) that lantern::ui's functions reach. The host surface now matches all 153 rows. The five Chaos headless_game tests run as tests/host programs over tests/support/platformer, on both backends. Also fixes #30's review nits: comments gone from the bridge, Mount's error is trimmed like Rust's, D-046's wording.
